decision: 5 second time penalty. (5 seconds added to elapsed Race time). Reason The Stewards reviewed video evidence and determined that the outside of both left hand tyres crossed the outside of the solid yellow line at pit exit in violation of the code. While the penalty guidelines indicate a penalty point, the Stewards elect not to apply a penalty point because (a) during the driver's meeting the drivers indicated that this line is difficult to see at this time of day, (b) his tyres crossed for less than a meter, and (c) there was no danger caused.
fact: Car 10 crossed the yellow line at Pit Exit.
offence: Breach of Appendix L, Chapter IV, Article 6 of the International Sporting Code.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
are based solely on the relevant regulations
title: Infringement Car 10 Crossing The Line At Pit Exit
to: The Team Manager, BWT Alpine F1 Team
